tags.description: Endpoints for managing student evidence items and skill verification records

tags.name: Learning Recommendation Service
tags.description: Endpoints for course discovery, skill gap learning recommendations, and progress tracking

tags.name: Career Intelligence Service
tags.description: Endpoints for discovering target roles, competencies, and career roadmaps

tags.name: Skill Service
tags.description: Endpoints for discovering skills, categories, student skills, and verifying skill competencies

tags.name: Profile Service
tags.description: Endpoints for managing student profile, resume uploads, and certificates

tags.name: Portfolio / Skill Passport Service
tags.description: Endpoints for generating public Skill Passport profiles, sharing verified credentials, and portfolio management

tags.name: Project Service
tags.description: Endpoints for project discovery, GitHub repository submission, and automated evaluation

tags.name: Assessment Service
tags.description: Endpoints for skill assessments, quiz sessions, submission evaluation, and skill verification

tags.name: Authentication Service
tags.description: Endpoints for user registration, login, token refresh, and session management

tags.name: Analytics Service
tags.description: Endpoints for aggregate dashboard data, competency progress, and student activity timeline

tags.name: Job Service
tags.description: Endpoints for job postings discovery, skill matching, and competency alignment metrics
